findings.reason: a coordinator reading §4 as done will never dispatch the judge stage, which then silently disappears from the plan.
findings.text: §4's text makes a Jev-backed asynchronous judge stage part of §4 ("They run as their own asynchronous judge stage in the review pipeline, beside the audit stage"), but §4's done-when measures only the deterministic conformance checks, and the section is declared `data-status="done"` with the close comment itself recording "Open within §4's text: the Jev-backed judge stage" — so §4 is closed on one deliverable while a second, named inside the same section, is unfinished

findings.reason: without a named home for the cap a node wires the prompt block, finds the document still accepted, and the section's gate cannot be met by the described change.
findings.text: §5 asserts "An unresolved lint error caps the documentation score below the acceptance threshold" as the mechanism that makes its own done-when ("A review over a seeded non-conforming document cannot accept it") true, but no module or caller enforcing that cap is named: the review pipeline carries only a general `score < 0.40` threshold (review/pipeline.py:1888) and no cap keyed to audit findings, so the rendering mechanism §5 does name (findings into the prompt) cannot by itself produce the capped outcome

findings.reason: with no declared edge, §5 can be dispatched before the entries exist and its gate measures an empty registry rather than the mechanism it asserts.
findings.text: the plan declares a dependency only for §2 (`{"s2":["imas-standard-names:concept-and-notation-registry#s2"]}`), yet §5 renders entries authored in §3 and the plan's own followup states "§5 follows once the WEST entries exist"; §5's done-when ("a rendered prompt for a flux-surface-averaged name carries the canonical equation") needs real entries from §3, and §3/§4 need the §2 accessor, none of which is declared

findings.reason: the module and the variable both resolve and the defect is real; only the line number has drifted, so the node's target is unambiguous and no plan change beyond correcting the citation is required.
findings.text: §5 locates the unwired route as "sets audit_findings on the render context at line 1964", but in imas_codex/standard_names/review/pipeline.py line 1964 is `prompt_name = "sn/review_docs"`; the render-context assignment `"audit_findings": audit_findings` is at line 1989

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the §5 pointer "sets audit_findings on the render context at line 1964" does not resolve (line 1964 is `prompt_name = "sn/review_docs"`); every other anchor resolves, including the cross-project ISN plan and the extensionless hrefs resolved as `<path>.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — every section's measured clause carries a negative control (§2 removed-concept registry, §3 removed-entry scratch registry, §4 canonical-entry-yields-zero plus revert-sensitive tests, §5 template-line-removed and cap-removed counterfactual); §1/§6 are narrative sections with no gate.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every cited path is a durable repository artifact (docs/research/sn-catalog-consistency-census, docs/evidence/fragments/sn-judgment-evaluation/flux-surface-average-smoke.html and .py, docs/evidence/fragments/sn-house-style/*, docs/evidence/archive/sn-house-style-landed.html); no scratchpad or node-local temporary path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the symbols the plan names (run_house_style_checks, house_style_findings, run_documentation_gate_checks, select_conventions) are named by mechanism; no plan label, stage name or ticket number enters code.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §5's cap mechanism ("an unresolved lint error caps the documentation score below the acceptance threshold") names no module or caller, so the described mechanism does not produce §5's own done-when.
rubric_items.single_goal: a finding — §4 carries two deliverables, the deterministic conformance checks and a Jev-backed asynchronous judge stage, and it is declared done with the second still open.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the declared external dependency (§2 on imas-standard-names:concept-and-notation-registry#s2) and the two blocks relationships resolve correctly, but the intra-plan dependencies the plan's own followup asserts (§5 "follows once the WEST entries exist") are not declared.
